My dear [Mr Moor](/person/1046)
Your letter followed me home from [Brighstone](/place/140) whence I returned on Wednesday. I will give you 10/ for St Pauls church when next I have an opportunity, but on Monday I am going to Oxford and I do not come back till the 12th

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge
